IndiGo raised its fuel charge from 6 October 2026. Its CEO, Willie Walsh, says fares may rise. Saudi cancellations were extended.

threads.title: Antonelli closing in on F1 title
threads.summary: Kimi Antonelli won the US Grand Prix, his ninth win, and went to Mexico 123 points ahead of George Russell. On 1 November he finished third in Mexico City and clinched the title at 20 years and 68 days, F1's youngest champion. Verstappen won the race after taking control at the only pitstop (lap 28 of 71), beating Hamilton, and moved to second in the standings. Next: the fight for second place.

threads.title: Cyclone Arnab hits India's east coast
threads.summary: A Bay of Bengal depression became Cyclone Arnab, making landfall near Yanam, Andhra Pradesh around October 28, 2026 with winds up to 150 km/h. Over 180,000 people were evacuated across Andhra Pradesh and Odisha. At least three deaths and flooding reported; recovery under way.
